headline: School Committee to discuss Chief Financial Officer contract, SKESP extension, staffing increases, and new high school status.
summary: The committee will hold an executive session on SKESP negotiations, a potential new Chief Financial Officer, and the Superintendent's evaluation. In open session, it will review purchase orders, homeschool requests, staffing changes, a CFO contract, and an update on the new South Kingstown High School project at Curtis Corner.
